notes.title: Relik B2 is here!
notes.content:
[h3]Major Update[/h3]
Relik B2 ("Beta 2") is a reworked version of the game based on your feedback.  We've simplified and improved Relik by focusing on what you love and removing the components that received less interest.

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Puzzle building has been completely removed.
[*] Friends list added!  Add friends and challenge them to battles where you control the puzzles.
[*] Standard PvP matches are comprised of (3) Puzzles - Runes, Mimic, and Variant
[*] Daily Reliks feature (4) Puzzles - Runes, Mimic, Variant, and Sequence
[*] Play Escape while waiting in match queue
[*] Improved UIs across the board
[*] Better, more intuitive Skin Management
[*] Earn rewards from Daily Reliks that can be used to purchase Skins
[*] Pick-a-cards have been removed
[*] Factions have been removed (for now...)
[*] Trophies reset for new version.
[/list]
[h3]Stable Mac Version coming soon![/h3]
Please bear with us as we work to create a Mac friendly version of Relik B2.  We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Update 0.11.1.4 is Live!
notes.content:
[h1] New Battle UI [/h1] 
Keep it clean.  We've implemented a more minimalist approach to our battle UI that shows you what you need in the heat of battle and nothing more.

[h1] New Tutorial[/h1] 
We've revamped the tutorial to focus on core game mechanics - solving and building - and less on UI navigation.

[h1] Bug Fixes[/h1] 
Variant replay works properly now.
Escape build mode Key sliding bugs have been fixed.
Other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Campaigns & Daily Reliks now live!
notes.content:
[h1]Violet Galaxy Campaign[/h1]
Fly through a beautiful Violet Galaxy solving increasingly difficult Reliks. Perfect all 20 levels and unlock the Relik Galaxy Theme!

[h1]Daily Reliks[/h1]
Solve three unique Reliks of varying difficulty with puzzles that change daily.  Race to the top of each Daily Relik's leader board. The top 3 finishers for each Relik earn glory and loot filled Card Packs!

[h1]Card Pack Rework[/h1]
We've simplified Relik Cards by removing "Pick a Cards" and replacing them with Card Packs.  Packs contain fewer cards but all of them can be flipped for free, and they're more uniform across the game.  This is critical since there are so many new ways to unlock card packs throughout Relik.

Happy Solving!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: Update 0.11.05 is Live!
notes.content:
[h1]New Feature[/h1]
[b]Training Interface-lift[/b]
We've made Training simpler and easier to follow for new players with a new UI and flow.  We'll carry this interface over to Relik Quests which are coming soon!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed false invalid design error on Escape
[*] Fixed Variant design when re-entering design mode
[*] Matches properly adapted to tiebreak rounds
[*] Several other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New Puzzles are Live!
notes.content:
[h1]New Puzzles are Live![/h1]
The wait is finally over!  New Relik puzzles are here!  Unlike most of the original puzzles which focused mostly on memory, the new Relik puzzles will test your quickness (Variant), problem solving (Escape), and perception (Maze Revamped). 

[h1]Variant [/h1] 
Quickly spot the out-of-place rune.  Race your opponent to 5 points.  You must be quick but careful as the wrong selection costs you a point or gives one to your opponent.

[h1]Escape[/h1] 
Slide blocks around to clear a path to the exit.  Forward is not always better; plan carefully, then make your move!  Build your highly custom Escape puzzle block by block to thwart your opponents.

[h1]Maze Revamp[/h1]
The Maze puzzle now only occupies one Relik face.  We've significantly increased the grid size on that face and most critically [b]reduced your opponent's vision[/b] to a small radius around the maze token!  Reduce that radius even further and increase your own token's speed by upgrading your Maze puzzle.

notes.title: New Puzzles and More Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1] Your #1 request addressed[/h1] 
More puzzles.  You've been asking for it since Relik was first released on Early Access.  Now that RT is complete and mostly bug free, we can move on to this often requested feature.  We have 3 puzzles in the works - 2 of which will make the final cut.  Targeted release is July 2018.

[h1]More Non-real-time Content[/h1]
Beta queue times are a beast. They're a beast we anticipated for by adding long queue bots and allowing building / training while in queue.  We want to do more + we have some great content ideas designed to work outside of real-time anyway.  Hang in there as we continue to flesh these out and add them to Relik over the next several weeks.

Happy solving!

notes.title: Real-time & Reset coming Thursday May 17th, 2018!
notes.content:
[h1] Real-time is finally here! [/h1]
Prepare to experience Relik in all its real-time glory.  Battle other players head to head, build Factions, sharpen your skills in practice mode, chat and trade in real-time, use new themes, and more!

[h1]Server-wide Puzzle / Currency Reset[/h1]
We have good news and bad news, and they're both the same: all player puzzles and currencies (with the exception of gems) will be reset for Relik RT. 
[list]
[*] This will ensure players start off on mostly even footing for RT
[*] [b]A free, exclusive Relik Theme for all early adopters[/b]
At the time of reset on Thursday, all existing players will receive an exclusive "Gamer" theme.  After May 17th, 2018, we will never release this theme again to anyone - ever. 
[*] Any currencies acquired through in-game purchases will be refunded. (eg: if you spent $0.99 on 100 gems, 100 gems will be added to your balance on reset)
[*] Gems, Themes, and Theme Cards will [b]not[/b] be affected by the reset.
[/list]

[h1]Match Queues[/h1]
[b]The Good[/b]
Matches are 1v1 so only 2 players are needed per match
You can do almost anything in game - like build your Relik - while in Queue

[b]The Bad[/b]
Active players dwindled over the 5 months it took us to make one huge update that works best with a lot of active players.

[b]Temporary Adjustment[/b]
Players in queue for over a set period of time may be offered a Bot.  Don't worry. She's harder, temporary, and balanced so players cannot bot boost.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
The new format does not work well with clocks or weekly leagues so both have been removed.

[h1]Your help[/h1]
Bugs happen.  Your [b]patience[/b] (and bug report if you like) is [b]much[/b] appreciated!

Help us minimize match queues.  Please tell a friend about Relik.

Happy Solving! 

- the Iron 27 team

notes.title: Real-time is coming May 2018!
notes.content:
[h1] From the ground up[/h1] 
As you might imagine, converting the game to real-time multiplayer is a few steps shy of creating Relik's core game play from scratch. Thanks for everyone's patience while we continue to work on this huge update.

We can finally say with a high level of confidence that we will be releasing Relik in all its real-time glory later this month, so stay sharp with classic mode and we'll post an exact date on RT as soon as we have it.

Happy Solving!

- The Iron 27 Team

We'll keep you updated with any major development updates and a timeline as soon as we have one.

Happy Solving!

- The Iron 27 Team

notes.title: 0.9.8 Live! (Major Update)
notes.content:
[b]Check out all the new features in our first Season 2 update below.[/b]

[h1]Three Maze Designs![/h1]
Players now unlock a new maze design slot at Maze level 5 and 10 for a total of three maze designs.  One of your maze designs is chosen at random when your Relik is attacked.  Memorizing your designs is now three times harder for attackers.

[h1]Maze Replays![/h1]
Watch attackers get lost in your maze.  Just pull up your defense history in Battle Logs and click 'Maze Replay' on the match details panel.

Note: maze replays will not start recording until this update, so only recent defenses will be recorded.

[h1]Revenge Attacks![/h1]
You asked for it, we made it. Want to exact revenge on someone who defeated your Relik?  Pull up the match in your Battle Logs and click Revenge to attack their Relik.

Note: players with an active shield cannot be attacked.

[h1]Polish and Bug Fixes[/h1]
[*]Welcome Panel added for new players (full tutorial coming soon).
[*] Improved the layout of Match Details panel.
[*] Fixed a puzzle selection bug
[*] Other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Upgrades heavily discounted. New Free Bundle!
notes.content:
We want Relik to be fun for all ages, and while low level puzzles may be great for beginners, our Early Access players are simply too good for the current balance.  

[h1]It's upgrade time![/h1]
1) We've heavily discounted upgrade costs on puzzle levels 1 - 15. (Puzzle cap increased to 25)
2) We've refunded everything players have spent in excess of the new upgrade pricing. 
3) We've issued a new Free bundle 'Early Access Mega Gift' in the shop that provides enough pieces and gold to upgrade all your puzzles to level 10!

Be sure to check out the shop for your free bundle!

Any comments, suggestions, or feedback?  Please let us know.

Happy Solving!

notes.title: 0.9.5.1 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Maze Token Acceleration 2.0[/h1]
Just like 0.9.4, The maze token now increases in speed if it has not reached an intersection (turns are not intersections) in 5 tiles.  Unlike 0.9.4, this speed is not fully reset on maze edges.  The token slows for the edge and rotation only.

[h1]Balance[/h1]
To adjust for acceleration above, all maze solve times have been reduced by roughly 8%.

[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1] 
- Even more double-click bug fixes.

Happy Solving!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: 0.9.4 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]New Feature - Maze Token Acceleration[/h1]
Creating a 2-path "all-or-nothing" maze is no longer a viable option.   The maze token now increases in speed if it has not reached an intersection (turns are not intersections) in 5 tiles.  The speed is capped at double, but this is great incentive to get creative with various forks and crossroads in your maze.

Edit: speed is also reset on maze edges, but we will be nerfing this a bit in today's patch.

[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1] 
- Throwing a server error is now much less likely to snowball into other errors and sync issues.
- Looking at your own profile should now always show accurate season / best trophies.
- More double-click bug fixes.
- Some of the (still rare, but...) more common PAC bugs.
- Other miscellaneous bugs.

[h1] Coming Soon - Casual Mode! [/h1]
You pick the difficulty and your trophies aren't affected - win or lose.  A great way to relax and enjoy the puzzles without worrying about ladder rank or level 20 bots.

Happy Solving!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: 0.9.3 Released!
notes.content:
Many thanks to the over 2,500 players that have downloaded Relik in just over 2 days. Your enthusiasm for the game has invigorated our team and we're pushing hard to improve Relik as much as we can.

We did not make an announcement for 0.9.2, but as you might guess, the theme of Relik's first two updates are Bug Fixes.

[h1] Big Bug Fixes [/h1] 
- Making and saving an unsolvable Rune puzzle should now be impossible.  As a failsafe, if somehow a player is able to make and save an unsolvable design, it will be replaced by a random solvable design when they are attacked (so don't even think about it)
- Upgrading a puzzle multiple times during its spin animation won't make it land on another puzzle.
- Multiple game crashing bugs have been squashed - including those on attack start and end.

[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1] 
- New players should much less frequently encounter "Initial connection failed" error.
- Game does not crash if you solve a puzzle in the last second.
- Battle history correctly shows Victory and Defeat icons based on Your perspective (instead of always the attacker's perspective)
- Fixed unread events icon
- Fixed battle history trophies
- Other small bugs.

[h1] Known Bugs we're still working on [/h1] 
- Game freezes on In App Purchase.  We've added additional debug in this patch for this.  Thanks for your patience while we work on taking your money better.
- Invalid PAC card count bug when game first loads.
- Various sync issues where the client and server don't agree on your currency and PAC amounts.
- Other small bugs.

We hope to have these fixed very soon. Please continue to send us your reports.

[h1] Features [/h1]
Thanks to your feedback and participation, we have a lot of ideas for new features.  We'd much rather work on these than bugs, but have a hard time chucking responsibility. Our plan is to get Relik very stable, then start cranking out some cool new stuff!

Happy Solving!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: Relik is Live on Early Access!
notes.content:
The Iron 27 team is thrilled to bring you Relik!  

[h1]Early Access [/h1] 
Relik is very stable and ready for you to enjoy.  You can start solving player puzzles and building your Relik now! We do have a few minor aesthetic issues we are still working on, but you likely won't even notice them and we'll be releasing updates often.

[h1]Mac Retina[/h1]
We pushed extra hard to make sure Relik was available on Mac as well.  We managed to pull this off, but we are not happy with the current resolution offered on Mac Retina displays.  We're working on it, so hang in there Retina users!

[h1]Bugs?[/h1]
Found a bug?  Please let us know about it!  We'll do our best to get them squashed ASAP.

Happy Solving!

- The Iron 27 Team

We pushed extra hard to make sure Relik was available on Mac as well.  We managed to pull this off, but we are not happy with the current resolution offered on Mac Retina displays.  We're working on it, so hang in there Retina users!

[h1]Bugs?[/h1]
Found a bug?  Please let us know about it!  We'll do our best to get them squashed ASAP.

Happy Solving!
